description: A white MacBook Pro box sits on a desk surface, and a yellow-and-black tape measure is being used over the top of it. The right hand brings the tape measure onto the box and pulls the yellow tape out while the left hand steadies the far edge, stretching the tape diagonally across the lid, then retracting and re-extending it to measure across the front edge and again on a diagonal; the tape measure stays a right-hand object while the left hand alternates between holding the box edge and guiding the tape end.
